description.id: Kisah lengkap, mukjizat, dalil Al-Qur'an, dan hikmah 25 Nabi dan Rasul yang wajib diimani dalam Islam berdasarkan sumber-sumber terpercaya (Tafsir Ibnu Katsir, Qashashul Anbiya', Shahih Al-Bukhari & Muslim).
description.en: Comprehensive stories, miracles, Quranic proofs, and wisdom of the 25 Prophets and Messengers based on authentic Islamic sources.

sources: Tafsir Al-Qur'an Al-'Azhim karya Al-Hafizh Ibnu Katsir
Qashashul Anbiya' karya Al-Hafizh Ibnu Katsir
Shahih Al-Bukhari & Shahih Muslim (Kitab Ahaditsul Anbiya')
Sirah Nabawiyah Ar-Rahiqul Makhtum karya Syaikh Shafiyyurrahman Al-Mubarakfuri
Al-Bidayah wan Nihayah karya Al-Hafizh Ibnu Katsir
